author: rozaru
body:
* **PTHR ID & PTN node:**
[PTN000343740](https://www.pantree.org/node/annotationNode.jsp?id=PTN000343740)
* **Sequences with problematic annotation (ID + gene/protein name):**
Alas O18680 5-aminolevulinate synthase
* **Type of Issue: Erroneous source or erroneous propagation, or other issue**
erroneous propagation
The term erythrocyte development: GO:0048821 is not applicable to Drosophila and likely to all insects as they don't make erythrocytes

* Add the label 'high priority' if needed. Generally high priority issues affect a lot of proteins, and annotations are incorrect (as opposed to just imprecise).
title: PTN000343740: erroneous propagation of erythrocyte development to Drosophila

author: pgaudet
body: Fixed, thanks for reporting the issue.
